unresolved_items: Evidence EVID_004 is partially_supported: A Rajasthan Tourism account of the Marwar Festival in Jodhpur presents Jodhpuri safas and bandhini dupattas as festival clothing.

Evidence EVID_008 is partially_supported: Rajasthan Tourism says Khejri trees are prominent in western Rajasthan and identifies Khejrli village near Jodhpur with the tree's name.
Evidence EVID_009 is partially_supported: Rajasthan Tourism describes the Marwar Festival in Jodhpur as featuring folk music and songs honoring former rulers of Marwar.
Evidence EVID_010 is partially_supported: Rajasthan Tourism describes Ghoomar performances at Mandore Garden during its Marwar Festival account.
Evidence EVID_011 is partially_supported: Rajasthan Tourism describes Toran-Bandan as a wedding custom in which a mounted groom touches a floral decoration over the bride's doorway.
Evidence EVID_012 is partially_supported: Rajasthan Foundation lists bajra, gram flour, corn, barley, and dairy products among common ingredients in Rajasthan cuisine.
